label: A necessary concrete individual from inert emptiness and a possible contingent-free past
meaning: New non-transcription conditional support option for stage one of the modal spine to God's existence. In the accessible history v, some contingent concrete individual is present at the later moment t, so v is not concrete-empty at t; by inert emptiness v is not concrete-empty at the earlier moment s, so (classically) some concrete individual c is present at s. Presence-to-existence gives that c exists at v. No contingent concrete individual is present at s, so c is not contingent at v: it is absent from no world accessible from v. Euclidean access and reflexivity at the selected world w carry the SAME c to w and to every world accessible from w. No causal, grounding or explanatory relation is used or concluded; the grounding field of the conclusion's profile is an arbitrary parameter. All five premises are OPEN framework inputs; no premise truth, uniqueness, underivedness or divine attribute is established. Classical reasoning enters through the three permitted Mathlib axioms.
